notes.title: The Death and Rebirth of VR Monster Awakens
notes.content:
In 2015, without any financial support, we developed the alpha version of [i][b]VR Monster Awakens[/b][/i] (VRMA) in nine months with a team of three. 

The alpha version of VRMA was first launched in early access on Steam in December 2016. Thanks for some VR YouTubers’ loves, the game gained some supports in the first few months. Unfortunately, the result was not satisfied enough and the financial outcome was not sufficient to support the development cost at that moment. We made a tough decision, to suspend the development of VRMA.

However, we have not given up this passionate VR game project. From 2016 to 2021, we accumulated resources piece by piece from various VR/AR/MR projects we completed and grew our team size and skills.

Now, after we get through hard times, we are happy to announce the development of VRMA is resumed! More than that, it is rebuilt from ground up and will only be even better!

VRMA will be launched on Steam and Oculus Quest App Lab.

If you want to know more about the development progress of VRMA, apply to be testers, wants to share your thoughts with us, please join our Discord server.
https://discord.com/invite/CG8gH9JRyk

We sincerely thanks for your support and looking forward to show more about VRMA to you.

notes.title: Calibration
notes.content:
[i]v0.5.1[/i] 
Hello Monsters! We want to thank you for your constant support.
[list] 
[*]Tracker Calibration in Settings, no more broken legs! 
[*]Bug fixes and Performance tuning. 
[/list] 
While we are developing the multiplayer feature, it turns out that we need to change extensive part of the code. It is making good progress now and we can continue our development of the followings: More content, New monster,Multiplayer

notes.title: Trackers, Oculus, Combo!
notes.content:
[i]v0.5.0[/i]
[img]http://fight4dream.com/steamuseimages/vrmonsterawakens/v0_5_0_GIF.gif[/img]
Hello Monsters! We are very excited to bring these features to you!
[list]
[*]Strap two [i]Vive Trackers[/i] on your feet, and you can Kick with your feet!
[*]Grab two [i]Touch[/i] controllers and you can play with [i]Oculus[/i]!
[*]Destroy quickly for combo score! How high can your score be?
[*]More languages support! Parlez-vous Français? Spreek je Nederlands?
[*]Bug fixes and Performance tuning.
[/list]
The fun never stops! Coming next is our new monster. Who is he?
Multiplayer is in progress too. Don't miss the fun!

notes.title: Fear my Beam Shot!
notes.content:
[i]v0.4.1[/i]
[img]http://fight4dream.com/steamuseimages/vrmonsterawakens/v0_4_1_GIF_BeamShoot-p.gif[/img]
Hello Monsters! Here are some of the key changes for the upcoming patch:
[list]
    [*]Main menu is renovated, added a news section.
    [*]Improved visual effect of Somnilla's Beam Shot!
    [*]The beam will be displayed correctly when viewed from airship.
    [*]Soldiers caught fire from the beam and other sources will flee instead of attack.
    [*]Soldiers will be dropped from damaged tanks and helicopters.
    [*]Reduced the nuclear bomb destruction radius when Boss Tank appears. 
    [*]Trigger tutorials in the right time.
    [*]Minor bug fixes.
[/list]
Have fun and enjoy the SMASH!

notes.title: Let's Jump!
notes.content:
[i]v0.4.0[/i]
[img]http://fight4dream.com/steamuseimages/vrmonsterawakens/v0_4_0_GIF_Jump01.gif[/img]
Hello Monsters! Here are some of the key changes for the upcoming patch:
[list]
    [*]New control methods. We have renewed the tutorial videos and added a control panel. 
    [*]Jump and stomp on where you landed.
    [*]Hop to the roofs to admire the city view before it crumbles under your might.
    [*]Score is listed on the leaderboard even being wasted. 
    [*]Added a Retry Button after being wasted. 
    [*]The enemies and citizen will be easier to catch up. 
[/list]
[img]http://fight4dream.com/steamuseimages/vrmonsterawakens/v0_4_0_GIF_Jump02.gif[/img]

Have fun and enjoy the SMASH!

notes.content:
[i]v0.3.1[/i]
[img]http://fight4dream.com/steamuseimages/vrmonsterawakens/0_3_1_Screen1.png[/img]
Hello Monsters! Key changes for the upcoming patch:
[list]
    [*]Unlock achievements!
    [*]Receive some health pots when you reached next area;
    [*]Fixed some objects that did not give score;
    [*]Fixed when objects are thrown, they may get through the ground;
    [*]Fixed main menu performance issue.
[/list]
Have fun and SMASH for the highest scores!
